Row 4: Operational Execution Wins vs Headwinds & Call Q&A Forensic Audit

What Management Did Right (Operational Wins)

  • 99.5% Two-Qubit Gate Fidelity: Met milestone benchmark across full 108 qubits on Cepheus-1-108Q (and 99.7% on 8Q sublattice), demonstrating industry-leading gate speeds of 50-70ns.
  • CHIPS Act $100M Agreement: Signed definitive contract with U.S. Dept of Commerce for $100M in non-dilutive scaling grants across cryogenics and fabrication.
  • Modular Architecture Validation: Successfully integrated twelve 9-qubit chiplets on silicon interposers with zero degradation in logic gate speeds compared to monolithic chips.
  • Year-to-Date Topline Growth: 9-month consolidated revenue reached $10.95M, growing +110% YoY compared to $5.22M for the first nine months of 2025.

Execution Challenges & Headwinds (Operational Drags)

  • Severe Revenue Contraction: Q3 revenue dropped -72.6% QoQ to $1.41M, missing Street consensus ($3.68M) by -61.68% due to delivery acceptance timing.
  • Accelerating Cash Burn: Quarterly true free cash burn widened to -$51.22M as Fab-1 cleanroom investments and cryogenic equipment purchases elevated CapEx to $26.20M.
  • Declining Liquid Cash Balance: Cash and cash equivalents declined to $45.80M from $67.67M in Q2 2026, increasing operational dependency on timely CHIPS Act milestone draws.
  • Dilution from Derivative Warrants: While warrant revaluations created a $25.29M paper gain in Q3, warrant liabilities remain a source of share count volatility.
Earnings Call Q&A Forensic Highlights (Hardest Analyst Questions)
David Williams (Benchmark Company) — Revenue Lumpiness & Delivery Timing vs Contract Delays

Question: Can you walk through what caused the top-line decline from $5.14M in Q2 to $1.41M in Q3? Were any Novera QPU purchase orders or government milestones cancelled or pushed into future quarters?

Executive Answer: Dr. Subodh Kulkarni (CEO): 'None of our contracted projects or Novera pipelines have been cancelled. Our revenue model in this nascent phase is heavily tied to delivery acceptance milestones. In Q2, we recognized multi-system Novera shipments and initial government phases; in Q3, our engineering resources were overwhelmingly committed to validating the Cepheus-1-108Q chiplet architecture and finalizing the $100M CHIPS agreement. We expect acceptance revenue to rebound sharply in Q4 and 2027.'

Forensic Assessment: ACCEPTANCE TIMING DRIVING REVENUE LUMPINESS
Craig Ellis (B. Riley Securities) — CHIPS Act $100M Award Tranches & Liquidity Runway

Question: With cash at $45.8M and quarterly cash burn around $17M-$26M with CapEx, when will the first capital disbursements from the $100M CHIPS agreement hit the balance sheet, and what are the matching fund requirements?

Executive Answer: Dr. Subodh Kulkarni (CEO): 'We have completed the definitive agreement with the Department of Commerce, and the first disbursements are tied to technical milestones across our three R&D initiatives: miniaturized readout electronics, advanced cryogenic cryostats, and high-connectivity chiplet fabrication. We expect initial funding disbursements to begin in the coming quarters, which substantially extends our operational runway into late 2027 without relying on dilutive equity financing.'

Forensic Assessment: DISBURSEMENTS TIED TO TECHNICAL MILESTONES
Quinn Bolton (Needham & Co.) — Chiplet Modularity vs Monolithic QPU Scaling

Question: Achieving 99.5% median fidelity across 108 qubits using twelve tiled 9-qubit chiplets is a technical milestone. How do inter-chip coupler losses compare to on-chip gate speeds, and what is the gating factor to 300+ qubits?

Executive Answer: Dr. Subodh Kulkarni (CEO): 'Our proprietary silicon interposer and 3D superconducting interconnect technology enable inter-chiplet quantum logic gates to operate at nearly identical 50-70 nanosecond speeds as on-chip couplers. The primary engineering hurdle to 300+ qubits is cryogenic wiring heat load, which our second CHIPS Act project directly solves by orders of magnitude through next-gen cryostat integration.'

Forensic Assessment: CHIPLET ARCHITECTURE VALIDATED OVER MONOLITHIC

Contained IV Crush
